param_sources.LoRa SNR thresholds: Semtech SX126x/SX127x datasheets (SF7 -7.5 dB ... SF12 -20 dB)
param_sources.LR-FHSS frame: RP002-1.0.5: ((L+2)*8+6)/CR coded bits, 48 bits per hop, shorter final hop; decode needs 1/3 (CR 1/3) or 2/3 (CR 2/3) of hops
param_sources.LR-FHSS Doppler tolerance: assumed: drift over one header <= 50% of 488 Hz
param_sources.NB-IoT (legacy continuous model) floor 3: only used when nbiot_model='continuous'; back-solved to 164 dB at 23 dBm / NF 3 dB
param_sources.LTE-M floor 224 bit/s, Eb/N0 5 dB: TR 36.888 Table 9.5.7.1-3 point (56 b, 250 reps, 2 PRB, -27 dB) quoted in RAN1#104e NTN summary; implies Eb/N0 5.06 dB
param_sources.NB-IoT NPUSCH: TS 36.213 TBS table (Rel-13, <= 1000 bits, segmentation above) and RU structure; Shannon-gap SNR with gap fitted to TBS1000/NRU10/Nrep32/-13.8 dB, which only beta = 1.0 ('link_level') reproduces; default beta = 0.5 is a hardware-inspired curve (single-tone 3.75 kHz measurements), corroborated not calibrated by RAN4 ratios; not a validated BLER model
param_sources.NB-IoT HARQ: chase combining of received energy over up to 2 attempts, feedback time RTT + 12 ms (assumed); no BLER curve
param_sources.NB-IoT burst rate: reported burst_rate_bps is the PHY burst rate of the selected configuration, not transaction goodput; no 20 kbit/s cap is applied in the table model
param_sources.NPRACH / PRACH CE configuration: assumed values chosen from TS 36.331 allowed sets; periodicity >= repetitions x preamble duration enforced
param_sources.NTN rate caps: legacy continuous model only: NB-IoT 20 kbit/s, LTE-M 300 kbit/s (assumed); LTE-M still uses the continuous model
